random numbers.description: Seeded 64-bit Mersenne Twister and a standard normal (needs <random>)
body: std::mt19937_64 gen{${1:42}}; // fixed seed: the same numbers every run

monte carlo.description: Monte Carlo loop: mean and standard error (needs <cmath>, <random>, <iostream>)
body: const double std_err = std::sqrt((sum_sq / n - mean * mean) / (n - 1));

fixed precision.description: Print doubles with a fixed number of decimals (needs <iomanip>)

approximately equal.description: Compare doubles with a tolerance instead of == (needs <algorithm>, <cmath>)
